## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `95c48c6f7ec8c522e06814011ffe2d764b92ea2f`
Local-runs: none
Scope: AGENTS.md, .github/workflows/ci.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, .github/workflows/ui-test-timings-refresh.yml + scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs, scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs, scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs, docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md, ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs (the two `ui/scripts/__tests__/*.test.ts` files are tests: the lane seat's ACCEPT at `TIER_DEFAULT`)

Inputs: card #31519 (body and all 9 comments, rulings 6722126387 / 6722137272 / 6722164201 / 6722440127 / 6722830321 / 6723247221 and dev report 6724224897 included), PR #31611 body and file list, the net diff of `95c48c6f` against its merge-base `8c75f837` (11 files, +1213 / −87), and the 67 check-runs on `95c48c6f`: every one `completed`, 48 `success`, 19 `skipped`, 0 failures. `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` are `success`, so `scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`, `check:shard-attestation`, `check:aggregator-roster`, `check:required-contexts` and `check-expected-skips` all hold on this tree. On the PR run itself `Queue verdict` and `Borrowed queue verdict` read `skipped` and every one of the eleven required contexts reports, which is the PR-event half of the contract observed live. The push-event half (the probe, the seed-only legs, the borrowed gate) has not executed on any run yet: it is judged below from the tree and the self-test batteries only.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Three aggregates gain a push-only skip arm** (`Test Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Test UI`: `if: always() && needs.queue-verdict.outputs.covered != 'true'`). Right. The probe runs on `push` alone (`if:` ends in `github.event_name == 'push'`, pinned by `borrowedVerdictWiring`), so on `pull_request`, `merge_group`, `schedule` and `workflow_dispatch` its output is the empty string and every aggregate is `always()` as before; no required context is removed from the events that gate a merge (card Wanted 3). `check-shard-attestation.mjs` admits exactly this spelling and refuses it without `queue-verdict` in `needs:` (8-case battery, read in the diff).
- **Every skip reads `!= 'true'` and every seed-only switch reads `== 'true'`.** Right, and pinned: `borrowedVerdictWiring` scans every non-comment line of ci.yml for `needs.queue-verdict.outputs.covered` and refuses any comparison with a literal other than `'true'`; the self-test exercises the `== 'false'` mutation against the checked-in ci.yml. A probe that is skipped, dies, times out or is never reached leaves the empty string, and the empty string runs everything. Every job that lists `queue-verdict` in `needs:` carries `!cancelled()` or `always()` (read at the head: `test`, `dogfood`, `build-docs`, `test-ui`, `build-e2e-ui`, `live-e2e-ui`, the three gates), so a failed probe job cannot block them.
- **`FULL_BATTERY_EVENTS` stays `['schedule', 'push']`, closed.** Right (card constraint). `merge_group` is read only as the source a borrowed push run names; `selectFullBatteryRun` is unchanged. `RELEASE_GATE_WORKFLOWS`' `ci.yml` row gains `borrows: true`; `lint.yml` has no probe and is read as before (self-tested: a lint push run asks for no record).
- **The release gate's borrowed path refuses by default.** Right. A deciding `ci.yml` push run with no record read is `pending` and refused, a record `{ error }` is refused, and only `{ record: 'full' }` (no `Borrowed queue verdict` job, or that job `skipped`) reads as today. `withBorrowRecords` reads exactly the pending runs, caps at 50 and throws on a record that stays pending (firing control in the battery). `selectSnapshotCommit` stops at a pending record rather than passing the commit over. The `--json` row gains `borrowedFrom` (additive; the record-shape pin is updated).
- **The probe's rules** (`pushedCommits` → `queueVerdict` → `queueRunVerdict`): single-parent first-parent walk from `after` to `before` over the compare API, refused on a zero or malformed `before`, `before == after`, a compare that is not `ahead` (a force-push), a merge commit, a walk that never reaches `before`, or more than 20 commits; per commit, the newest `merge_group` run of ci.yml on that sha by `run_started_at` then id, in any state, which must be `completed`, `success`, and whose ref `gh-readonly-queue/main/pr-N-BASE` names the commit's first parent. Right against the queue's own mechanics: the queue's Test UI select step reads `github.event.merge_group.base_sha` (ci.yml line 4100 at the head), and Test Core's `--affected` reads the same base, so "same sha, same base" is exactly "the queue's affected set is this commit's diff". `runQueueVerdict` never throws and the CLI exits 0 on every decided outcome; a 403, a 500 past the 3-attempt / 1.5 s ladder, a shapeless body and a transport crash each read `covered=false` (battery, 17 cases, the three deliberate reds included).
- **Q2 = B's two halves.** Right. The probe answers `ui_full_green` only when all sixteen `Test UI (k/16)` jobs of the head's queue run concluded `success` (15 of 16, or an unreadable jobs list, keeps Test UI running); `borrowed-verdict` recomputes the selection with `ui/scripts/select-affected-tests.mjs --base HEAD^1` at `fetch-depth: 2` and skips only on a literal last line `mode=full`. The selector imports node builtins and its two siblings only (`invoked-as.mjs`, `workspace-root.mjs`) and diffs `base...HEAD`, whose merge-base at depth 2 is `HEAD^1` itself, so the no-install checkout is enough. Any other outcome, a selector error included, is `test_ui=run`, and `test-ui`'s `!= 'skip'` treats an absent output the same way.
- **Seed-only legs (Q1 = A).** Right, and verified against the steps that still run after the two early exits. Test Core: the plan, "Build this shard's dependency closure" and the remote-cache assertion run as today; the assertion's `--move-summary-to` renames the one closure summary out of `.turbo/runs`, so "Check this shard's timing drift" (no `if:`) reads no summary and exits 0 NOT MEASURED, "Test completeness guard" and "Capture this shard's test timings" exit 0 on a missing `test-core.log`, and the prune reads `$RUNNER_TEMP/turbo-remote-cache` (the closure summary) and saves. Dogfood: the closure build gains `--summarize` only on a seed-only leg (a run option, no task-hash input), so its prune of `.turbo/runs` finds the build summary; the completeness guard exits 0 on a missing `dogfood.log`. The attestation pair carries `if: needs.queue-verdict.outputs.covered != 'true'` on BOTH steps and no status function, so the implicit `success()` still holds; the admitted spelling and its `needs:` requirement are exact-string in `check-shard-attestation.mjs`. The `OS_SEED_ONLY` env + early `exit 0` keeps the test step the one dispatch-gates reads (dev deviation, stated).
- **What a covered push still runs, read at the head.** The three main-only jobs keep `needs: filter` and read nothing of the probe (`MAIN_ONLY_JOBS` pin, self-tested by a mutation of `temporal-conformance`'s `needs:`). Type Check UI and Lint UI run and their Turbo seeds save on `push` only (read: both prune/save pairs are `github.event_name == 'push'`), so keeping them is right and dev deviation (a) is correct. Build Core and Build UI Deps run. Build Docs' Next.js cache also saves on `schedule`; Build & E2E UI's Playwright save is `cache-hit != 'true'`, event-agnostic; Live E2E UI has no push-conditioned step. So nothing a covered push skips starves a seed that only a push could write.
- **Timings refresh.** `select-shard-timings-run.mjs` already read `schedule` only; `ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs` `selectRuns` now lists `event=schedule` only, and the refresh workflow's two prose lines say so. Right and forced by Q2 = B.
- **What a push run can now skip that it used to catch.** Only a second run of the same test on the same tree: a flake that reads red the second time (4 of 136 push runs in the design note's window, flakiness NOT MEASURED). Every other push-only width is kept (Type Check UI, Lint UI) or re-derived (Test UI whole-suite). For a multi-commit push the push-wide `--affected` union is replaced by each commit's own queue run on its own first parent; the residual trust (a package changed in an earlier commit and unaffected by a later one tests the same on the final tree) is the same trust the queue itself rests on. The 4-hourly `schedule` run is untouched and is the full battery (ruling #25771 Q6 = C), and a push whose queue run is still `in_progress` at push time (the queue merges on the required set) reads NOT COVERED and runs in full: a lost saving, not a lost verdict.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff touches two workflows, root `scripts/`, `ui/scripts/` tooling, `AGENTS.md` and `docs/agents/`; nothing under `packages/` or any published entry changes. `Clause-②: no` on the PR body matches the card (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`). The one exported-shape change (`RELEASE_GATE_WORKFLOWS` row `borrows`, `--json` row `borrowedFrom`) is tooling the same file consumes, pinned by its own self-test.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Design-note questions.** Q1 = A and Q2 = B were answered by the seat in 6722137272; both are implemented as answered. The two surfaces the note asked about (`docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`; the `check:shard-attestation` / `check:required-contexts` pins) were admitted in 6722137272; `ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs` + test in 6722164201; `check-aggregator-roster.mjs` anchors + `ui-test-timings-refresh.yml` prose in 6722440127; `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` in 6722830321. The file list is exactly those plus the claim's own surface: no file outside the admitted surface.
- **Dev deviations (a)–(d) and the two others** are stated in the PR body and each is judged right above ((a) Lint UI's push-only seed; (b) a closure-only seed; (c) `Dogfood Regression Gate` skips while `Dogfood Verify CLI`'s own conclusion stands; (d) two exact spellings; env-guard exits; the AGENTS.md re-wrap, verified word-identical outside the "Two speeds" sentence, 1050 lines, `check:required-contexts` green on the head).
- **Escalation — the serial clause.** The head's merge-base `8c75f837` is 20 first-parent merges behind `origin/main` (`69244406`), which has since landed PR #31429's ci.yml edits (`e1158411`, the depth-1 checkouts in `test-plan`, `test` and `test-ui`). A read-only `git merge-tree` of the merge-base, `origin/main` and the head shows ci.yml "changed in both" with no conflict hunk, and the probe's own checkouts are separate steps, so the two changes compose. The claim's own serial clause (6723247221) says whichever lands second merges `origin/main` and re-runs before landing: that merge moves the head, and this record names `95c48c6f` only. The seat decides whether the maintainer hand-merges this head (allowed by the clean merge-tree) or the branch is refreshed first, in which case a record is owed on the refreshed head.
- **Follow-ups the tree cannot answer:** card Acceptance 1 (7 days of covered pushes skipping, the rest in full) and 3 (runner-minutes per push run before and after, on the card) are post-landing measurements; Acceptance 2 (the release gate's self-test covers the borrowed and the no-queue-run paths) is met in the diff. Flakiness of the four red push runs in the design note's window stays NOT MEASURED, as the note says.

### ④ Design judgment

**`.github/workflows/ci.yml`** — holds against the code it cites and the scenario it is accepted against. The `queue-verdict` job: push-only `if:`, `actions: read` + `contents: read` (the compare, the listings and the jobs read need nothing more), sparse checkout of `scripts/` with no install (the script's four sibling imports are all under `scripts/`), `continue-on-error` on the one step that decides, a 5-minute timeout that the read ladder (at most 22 reads × 3 attempts × 1.5 s) cannot reach. The `borrowed-verdict` job keeps the name the gate reads, runs only on `success() && covered == 'true'` (both pinned as exact strings), and its Test UI decision fails toward running. The head commit's addition of the two pr-event terms changes no behaviour (the push term decides) and is mirrored in the pins. The seed-only legs, the gates and the main-only jobs are judged in ①. Findings:

- **nit** — the `queue-verdict` job's checkout and setup-node steps sit outside `continue-on-error`, so a transient failure there reds the push run (a false main-red) while the battery still runs in full. Correctness and the contract are unaffected, and it is the exposure every job's checkout has; accepted deviation or a follow-up card.
- **nit** — the comment "release.yml's `full-battery` runs it the same way" is true of the no-install half only: `full-battery` checks out at `fetch-depth: 0`, not sparse. Prose face.

**`.github/workflows/release.yml`** — comment only; it states the borrowed path as HALF 3 implements it (the queue run named by the borrowed run must be green on the same commit's first parent). Holds. No finding.

**`.github/workflows/ui-test-timings-refresh.yml`** — two prose lines; both agree with `selectRuns` reading `event=schedule` only and with its NOT MEASURED text. Holds. No finding.

**`AGENTS.md`** — the "Two speeds" sentence now says the scheduled runs carry the full battery and a push run carries it by running the main-only jobs and borrowing the rest from the green queue runs of its commits, with the detail link unchanged. True of the tree: the eleven names, the advisory sentence and the Main-red sentence are byte-identical, and the release gate still reads every push run as a full-battery verdict, through the queue run when it borrowed. Holds. No finding.

**Implementing files** — `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` HALF 3 and HALF 4 agree with the contract sentence by sentence (read above); the two new batteries (15 + 17 cases) cover each refusal named in the design note and the wiring pins mutate the checked-in ci.yml. `scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs`: the two admitted spellings are exact strings, each requires `queue-verdict` in `needs:`, the `#6082` refusal otherwise stands, and the 8-case battery includes the one-step, widened, `== 'false'` and missing-`needs:` mutations. `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs`: anchors only, `queue-verdict` declared a non-member on all three gates. `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`: the new paragraph matches the tree (what still runs, what is borrowed, every refusal runs the whole battery, the gate re-reads the head's queue run, the schedule is unchanged). `ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs`: `selectRuns` lists and filters `schedule` only. No finding on any of them.

Nits only; the round ends here. The seat should read the first covered push run on `main` after landing (the probe's step summary, the `Borrowed queue verdict` job, and that the Test Core and dogfood seeds saved) as the live confirmation this record could not make from a PR-event run.

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`main` 的 push 运行先读合并队列的结论。本次 push 的每个提交都在其第一父提交上有一次全绿的队列运行时,push 只跑 main 专属作业、保存缓存种子,其余测试从队列借用结论;缺一个、红一个、基不对或读取失败,就照旧跑全套。每 4 小时的定时全量运行不变。
- 为什么改:897 次 push 运行里 896 次在重测队列刚测过的同一棵树,每次约 260 分钟 runner 时间。
- 风险与回滚:读不到或读错一律按"未覆盖"跑全套;发布门禁对借用的 push 会回读其队列运行。尚未实测的是 push 一侧(探针、只存种子的分片、借用作业)——它只会在合并后的第一次 push 上首次运行,由本席读取。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 新增的 `queue-verdict` 与 `Borrowed queue verdict` 两个作业,`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` 的 HALF 4。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test` 与 `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test` 都应 exit 0。
- 需要你做的:批准或亲手合并本 PR(Tier H)。契约复核 PASS 在案:评论 6725118793,`Head-sha: 95c48c6f7ec8c522e06814011ffe2d764b92ea2f`。
- 席位意见:建议合。分支落后 main 20 个合并(含 #31429 对 ci.yml 的改动),`git merge-tree` 无冲突;合并队列会在最新 main 上重建验证,所以不再为合 main 移动已复核的 head。

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · 2026-11-08T18:07Z · head `95c48c6f7ec8c522e06814011ffe2d764b92ea2f`

Seat `domain:devx#2` reviewed the diff of its own dispatch (claim 6722027476 on #31519, amendments 6722137272 / 6722164201 / 6722440127 / 6722830321 / 6723247221, card thread `session_01QsR2jQztfi9hnsaBeBVcCU`, report 6724224897). Checked against GitHub, not against the report.

1. **Shape:** 11 files, +1213 / -87: `ci.yml` (+the two new jobs, the covered conjuncts, seed-only exits), `release.yml` and `ui-test-timings-refresh.yml` (prose), `AGENTS.md` (the Two-speeds sentence; the paragraph re-wrapped word-identical, 1050 lines), `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`, `scheduled-full-run.mjs` HALF 3/4 + self-test, `check-shard-attestation.mjs`, `check-aggregator-roster.mjs` (fixture anchors only), `ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs` + test, `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` (one assertion). All inside the claim as amended. Body: `Fixes #31519`, `skip-changeset`.
2. **Premise:** step 1 and the design note 6722126387 (Q1 = A seed-only legs, Q2 = B Test UI borrowed only on a whole-suite queue run) were ruled before code; the deviations (a)–(d), the `OS_SEED_ONLY` exits and the AGENTS.md re-wrap are listed in the body with reasons, as ruled.
3. **Gates / check-runs:** on this head 62 runs, 52 success, 10 skipped, 0 red. `check-expected-skips` against main's roster reads exit 4 on `Queue verdict` and `Borrowed queue verdict`, which are new jobs main's roster cannot hold. Judged by the PR head's own roster (`--check-runs-json` from a checkout of `95c48c6f`): OK, 10 skipped, every one in the roster, exit 0. Patch round 1 (`80eca7dc` → `95c48c6f`) respelled both job `if:`s so the derivation reads them; without it every PR head on the board would have read these skips as unexpected after landing. Dev: 83 derived gates exit 0, `--ran` 83/83.
4. **Accepted deviations:** the contract review's two nits stand as accepted. `queue-verdict`'s checkout/setup steps sit outside `continue-on-error`, so a transient failure there reds the push run while the battery still runs in full. And one `ci.yml` comment overstates how `full-battery` checks out. The head is 20 merges behind `main`, including #31429's `ci.yml` edits (`e115841191`); `git merge-tree` is clean, and the merge queue builds the merged tree, so the reviewed head is kept rather than moved by a main merge.
5. **Out of scope / Skills-docs:** card Acceptance 1 (7-day skip rate) and 3 (runner-minutes before/after) are post-landing readings owed by this seat; Acceptance 2 is met in the diff. `Metadata-protocol: none`; `Skills-docs:` not owed (AGENTS.md is the governed text and is in the reviewed scope).
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges`: governed, Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`, `AGENTS.md`). `Clause-②: no`. Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`: PASS, record 6725118793 on this head (an isolated Fable reviewer adopted by this seat, under the maintainer's 16:12Z rule that a lane runs its own review while the director is off). The maintainer merges by hand, or an authorized approval (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS`) and then the seat lands it. Post-landing duty, owned by this seat: read the first covered push run on `main`. Its probe, seed-only legs and borrowed gate run there for the first time.
